title: Product Role
description:
**About Cartesia**
Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
  
  
We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
  
  
We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Product Support Engineer**
to help our customers succeed with our platform by solving complex, technical issues and providing world-class support. You’ll work directly with customers, partner closely with engineering and product teams at a cutting-edge AI company, and help shape the processes and tools that define our post-sales support. This is a hands-on role where your feedback will influence the roadmap, improve product reliability, and set the standard for how our customers experience Cartesia.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for support inbound from numerous sources like Slack, Pylon, WhatsApp, and other messaging platforms.
* Deliver white-glove support for our customers, diagnosing and resolving complex issues quickly and efficiently.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer teams to become a trusted technical partner.
* Reproduce customer issues, perform first-pass triage, write clear bug reports, and help prioritize fixes to unblock users quickly.
* Troubleshoot across the stack: API errors, model behavior, latency/reliability issues, and partner integrations.
* Be a customer champion: give feedback on features, spot edge cases, and influence roadmap and quality standards.
* Document solutions and patterns in runbooks and contribute to customer-facing documentation and best practices.
* Proactively identify recurring and high-friction issues before they escalate, and build the solution.
* Ship tooling and automations that close operational gaps and streamline how the team resolves issues.

What You Bring
  
  

* 2–8 years in a technical support, product support, technical account management, or forward-deployed engineering role.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills with APIs, SDKs, logs, and integrations.
* Familiarity with AI tooling, APIs, or agentic systems.
* Comfortable reproducing issues, debugging errors, and collaborating with engineers to identify solutions.
* A builder mentality: can identify chokepoints in process and tooling and build to close gaps.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to distill complex technical problems for both internal teams and customers.
* Calm under pressure and able to prioritize effectively when multiple customer issues arise simultaneously.
* High ownership and collaborative mindset, excited to contribute to a small, fast-moving team.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Scripting experience in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar to reproduce, mock, or validate issues.
* Experience in fast-moving startup environments where the product ships frequently and customers are often in early/beta.
* Interest in tinkering with new features, debugging edge cases, and exploring workflows hands-on.

WSP is currently seeking an Principal Engineer – Pedestrian Modelling to join our Rail and Transit Division in Bengaluru, with 8 to 14 years of experience in developing, calibrating and analysing pedestrian and crowd simulation models for railway stations, metro, LRT systems, and large transit facilities. The role involves applying advanced modelling tools and data-driven techniques to optimise passenger flow, station design, and crowd management strategies across various transportation projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop, calibrate, and maintain advanced passenger behaviour simulation models across multiple transportation modes, including rail, bus, air, and urban mobility systems.
* Apply both static and dynamic modelling techniques, integrating data-driven insights such as demographics, user preferences, and crowd dynamics to improve accuracy and realism.
* Validate, test, and document simulation models to ensure quality, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—such as data scientists, software developers, and project managers—to integrate models into products and project deliverables.
* Prepare clear technical reports, visualizations, and presentations to communicate modelling results and insights to clients and stakeholders.
* Engage directly with clients to understand requirements, tailor simulation approaches, and provide technical support throughout implementation.
* Monitor emerging trends and research in passenger behaviour and modelling techniques to continuously improve methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior team members, fostering knowledge-sharing and professional development.
* Foster collaboration across WSP within India and globally.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Other duties as assigned/required.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Proven experience in developing passenger behavior simulation models within transportation, urban planning, or related industries.
* Direct experience in both static and dynamic passenger modelling, such as Legion, Viswalk, CAST and MassMotion will be an asset.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and/or Excel with VBA.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work on complex mathematical models and algorithms.
* Knowledge of data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., MATLAB, R) is a plus.
* Familiarity with transportation systems, crowd dynamics, and human factors is highly advantageous.
* Previous involvement in the development of the Crowd Control Plan (CCP) will be an asset.
* Previous experience in performing passenger movement analysis in major transit facilities will be an asset.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Passion for innovation and a desire to contribute to the future of passenger experience in the transportation industry.
* Exposure to international delivery models and remote collaboration.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Urban/Transportation Planning, Civil/Transportation Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

* Extensive experience delivering complex system software and technical leadership of large, globally distributed engineering organizations within embedded or infrastructure SoC space.

* Use advanced monitoring tools (DCIM, Site Scan/Alber, SNMP tools, CCTV systems) to proactively identify and respond to events before service degradation occurs.
* Govern Data Center physical security standards including badge provisioning, video retention policy, rack access control, and compliance with security audits (SOX, ISO 27001).

* Drive automation initiatives (scripted monitoring checks, digital logging, dashboarding, alert tuning) to reduce manual intervention.
* Participate in Data Center Strategy programs — migrations, cloud transitions, hardware tech refreshes, cage expansions, smart access solutions.
* Conduct BCP/DR failover drills with Infrastructure Teams and ensure recovery objectives are always met.
* Mentor junior engineers in operations best practices and oversee knowledge transition to new team members.
* Represent Data Center Operations in global governance forums and leadership reviews.
* Champion ESG goals: reducing power consumption and improving PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness). Expected Outcomes & Performance Measures

**Job Title**

**Job Description**

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. Platform Enablement helps engineering teams adopt cloud platform capabilities confidently and independently. We're an advisory and acceleration function — we provide guidance, patterns, and reusable tooling, not approvals, and not ongoing operational support. Success is measured by what teams can do without us, not by how many tickets we close.

We're looking for an engineer who can run enablement engagements with growing independence — taking architectural guidance from senior team members and applying it directly with engineering teams. * Provide architectural guidance on well-established patterns, under the direction of a senior engineer for anything outside your depth.
* Run time-boxed enablement engagements of moderate complexity, with clear scope and a defined handover.
* Contribute to and maintain a library of reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules and CI/CD pipeline templates.
* Help define and apply engineering standards consistently across engagements.
* Provide short, structured hyper care support after handover.
* Maintain clear documentation (runbooks, onboarding guides, decision logs) as you go.
* Help track engagement and support data to spot recurring issues, and flag them upward.
* Surface early signals of platform friction to senior engineers for escalation.

* 4–6 years in infrastructure, platform, or DevOps engineering roles.

+ Cloud infrastructure: AWS
+ CI/CD pipelines (GitLab or equivalent)
+ Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent)
+ Observability tooling (e.g. Open Telemetry, Honeycomb, CloudWatch)
+ ITSM/workflow tooling (e.g. ServiceNow, Jira) for engagement and request tracking

* Clear written and verbal communication — able to document decisions and explain trade-offs to engineering teams.
* Comfort taking direction from senior engineers while building toward independent ownership.
* A documentation-first habit — you write things down as you go, not after the fact.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with API gateway technologies (e.g. Kong)
* Familiarity with Internal Developer Portal concepts
* On-prem infrastructure: VM provisioning and lifecycle management, workload orchestration (e.g. Nomad), secrets management (e.g. Vault), artifact management (e.g. Artifactory)

We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. * Lead and Inspire: Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* Think Big: Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* Champion the client: Understand and prioritise client's needs
* Deliver at pace: Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* Raise the bar: Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback

We’re committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey. Learn more about our D&I approach here.

title: D2C Growth Lead
description:
**About the Company**

We run growth for a portfolio of fast-growing D2C brands — skincare, beauty, apparel, lifestyle, wellness, food. Multiple Growth Leads, each owning several brands.

**About the Role**

The problem we're hiring for is a structural leak in how learning and innovation spread across our portfolio. You are not another Growth Lead. You take the highest-value growth thinking emerging from the Founder, from individual Growth Leads, and from individual accounts — and you inject it across the organisation so that the Founder's best thinking stops depending on the Founder being personally present in every account.

**Responsibilities**

*The mandate:*

* You are not another Growth Lead. You take the highest-value growth thinking emerging from the Founder, from individual Growth Leads, and from individual accounts — and you inject it across the organisation.

*Two responsibilities:*

**1) Transfer learning across the portfolio**

* When something works, you establish what worked, why, whether it's replicable, which brands it applies to, how it needs adapting, who implements it, whether they actually did, and what it produced.
* When something breaks in one account, you find out whether it's forming elsewhere.
* Individual problem → repeated pattern → systemic solution.

**2) Operationalise the Founder's innovation**

* The Founder develops new frameworks by applying them to a specific brand.
* You learn that thinking deeply enough to take it beyond that brand — extract the principle, convert it into a repeatable system, document it, train Growth Leads on it, drive adoption, measure impact.
* Founder insight → framework → playbook → training → implementation → measurement.

*What you'll own*

* The growth operating system — frameworks, audit processes, diagnosis methods, experimentation structures, prioritisation systems, playbooks, SOPs
* Cross-portfolio knowledge transfer — winning strategies worth replicating, failed experiments worth not repeating, bottlenecks showing up in more than one place
* Growth Lead enablement — making the people executing significantly better at diagnosing, prioritising and thinking strategically
* The question you'll ask constantly: if we solved this once, why is anyone solving it from scratch again?

*AI is core to this role*

* Not a productivity tool — part of the operating system.
* We expect aggressive, sophisticated use of AI for pattern-finding across accounts, summarising learnings, building playbooks, generating hypotheses, analysing performance data, and building internal tools and workflows.
* We want someone who actively experiments with new tooling and finds leverage the rest of the team hasn't.

*How you'll be measured*

* Speed of transfer of successful strategies.
* Reduction in duplicated mistakes.
* Number of Founder-led innovations actually operationalised and adopted.
* Adoption and quality of growth frameworks.
* AI workflows shipped and the manual work they removed.
* Systemic problems identified and solved.
* Not the growth of one portfolio — the growth capability of the company.

**Qualifications**

* **5+ years**
  in D2C growth, performance marketing, or growth consulting
* Experience across multiple brands, not one

**Required Skills**

* Working fluency across the D2C stack: Meta, Google, influencer, email, WhatsApp, CRO, retention, funnel analytics, AOV/LTV, CAC/ROAS/MER, unit economics, forecasting, P&L fundamentals
* Systems thinking — you see one event and ask whether it's a pattern
* Exceptional at learning something complex and teaching it simply
* Able to challenge people constructively and drive adoption without hierarchy
* You should be able to move between a client account, a spreadsheet, a strategy session with the Founder, an AI workflow, and a company-wide operating framework.

**Pay range and compensation package**

* Compensation ₹15–25 LPA + bonus.

**How to Apply**

* Send your resume plus a short note answering:
* "Tell us about something you figured out that other people then started doing. What was the decision, and how did you get it adopted?"

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Applications will be evaluated solely on merit and role fit.

title: MANAGER - MEDIA PLANNING
description:

* **Interrogate every brief before planning begins.**
* Is the budget sufficient for the stated goals?
* Are the KPIs measurable and connected to business outcomes?
* Is the audience defined specifically enough to drive targeting decisions?
* Apply R&F benchmarks to validate that plans achieve media sufficiency.
* Build channel mix rationale grounded in audience insight, not habit or default allocation.
* Connect media decisions to the client's growth challenge, not just their channel preferences.

* Build and analyze audience profiles using Scarborough, Arima, Experian, and Placer.ai, translating behavioral insight into channel and messaging implications.
* Stay current on media effectiveness research, channel best practices, and industry trends — bring them to the plan proactively, not when asked.

**Measurement & Performance**

* Collaborate with analytics on defining KPIs and success metrics before the plan is finalized.
* Support with measurement frameworks that connect media activity to business outcomes.
* Monitor in-flight performance and flag pacing issues, R&F shortfalls, or optimization opportunities.

* Review junior planners' work with a coaching lens — explain the why, not just the fix.

* Research & intelligence: Scarborough, Arima, MediaRadar, Placer.ai

* Demonstrated independence in plan development — owns the process, not just the outputs.

* Ability to interrogate a brief and identify gaps before planning begins.
* Proficient across planning, research, and reporting tools listed above.
* Understands how channel decisions connect to business and audience outcomes — not just media metrics.
* Solid written and verbal communication; can present a plan rationale clearly and defend it when pushed.
* Attention to detail that shows up in the work, not just in a self-description.
